Description: Tony Dauer and Edmund Galley talk and clash in the Dining room. Edmund pours himself a drink and discusses personal matters. Eventually thunder sounds and Tony leaves the room.
Location: Dining room（Dining room）
Key Information:
  - Edmund Galley and Tony Dauer drink and talk in the Dining room, discussing a bracelet, the pantry key, and other topics.
  - Tony Dauer finds a bracelet and discusses its special significance with Edmund.
  - Edmund mentions the bracelet upstairs and says he and Tony have become ‘eternal partners’.
  - Tony demands Edmund hand over the pantry key, but Edmund refuses and insists they won’t talk business.
  - They keep drinking. Edmund’s mood fluctuates; he mentions loss and unmet expectations, seemingly recalling the previous deceased No. 7.
  - Thunder sounds. Edmund breaks down emotionally; the phone keeps ringing.
  - After the thunder, Tony leaves the room, possibly taking the gun.
Characters:
  [Edmund Galley（Edmund Galley）] Person No. 6, emotionally unstable, talking with Tony in the Dining room.
    · Talks with Tony about the bracelet and the pantry key, showing mood swings.
    · Mentions loss and unrealized expectations, revealing deep longing for past relationships.
    · After thunder, becomes highly emotional, choking up and saying he can’t take any more.
  [Tony Dauer（Tony Dauer）] Person No. 4, armed, demands the pantry key from Edmund.
    · Discusses the bracelet and pantry key with Edmund and demands the key.
    · Stays calm and firm, refusing to put down the gun.
    · After thunder, leaves the Dining room without further reaction.
